```{python}
#| echo: false
# this will all disapper inside the study class

from owlroost.catalog.context import build_catalog_context
from owlroost.display.loaders import load_case_rows, load_run_rows
from owlroost.display.materializers.compare import materialize_compare_table
from owlroost.display.materializers.materialize import materialize_view
from owlroost.display.renderers.markdown_table import render_markdown_table
from owlroost.display.operations.table_ops import inject_id_column

from owlroost.workspace.loaders import (
    load_workspace_row,
)

(
    schema_registry,
    metrics_registry,
    display_registry,
    catalog_rows,
    catalog_index,
) = build_catalog_context()

workspace_row = load_workspace_row( "." )

CASE_FOLDER = workspace_row.get("cases_dir",".")

```

```{python}
#| echo: false
description = workspace_row.get("workspace_description","")
print(description)

```

## Cases Listing

Below is a list of cases used for this study.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# this gets replaced with study.list_cases( view )  # what engine?

rows = load_case_rows(CASE_FOLDER, metrics_registry=metrics_registry)

pivot = False
level = "case"
view = "cases"
explain_facets = None

table = materialize_view(
    rows=rows,
    registry=display_registry,
    catalog_index=catalog_index,
    level=level,
    view_name=view,
    mode="pivot" if pivot else "table",
    explain_facets=explain_facets,
)

output = render_markdown_table( table )
print(output)
```

## Results listing

Below is a table of run results generated for this study.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

rows = load_run_rows( metrics_registry=metrics_registry,results_root="results" )

pivot = False
level = "run"
view = "results"
explain_facets = None

table = materialize_view(
    rows=rows,
    registry=display_registry,
    catalog_index=catalog_index,
    level=level,
    view_name=view,
    mode="pivot" if pivot else "table",
    explain_facets=explain_facets,
)

output = render_markdown_table( table )
print(output)
```
